comparison.objective: Rout a curved board edge using the starting pin and bearing-guided bit; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record braces and pivots a board into a cutter, then feeds it safely around a bearing. Candidate aligns stationary support profiles and slides a block across their interface while containing balls.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires routed length and safe feed direction while invalidating off-pin entry, kickback patterns and hand proximity. Candidate requires complete transfer, ball retention and absence of gap, inclination, jam, impact or contamination.
comparison.reason: Safe cutter engagement and guided material removal do not test rolling-element containment or rail-to-jig transfer.
